item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
It is indeed!
This tale in particular wasn't intended to be amusing. The characters themselves have the potential to be funny, and to get themselves into funny situations, but I felt like I would be doing the full story an injustice if I didn't give them as realistic a reaction as I could to being sent out on yet another mission in which any or all of them could die.
As for the ham… You can expect to see Hammy up and linked into Vince's tale after the contest is over! I do hope you like him- he's been several months of thought in the making. He simply did not make it into the main contest due to time constraints. I have a feeling our friendly digital buddy will be well-received- fingers crossed!
'Shank's for asking, hehehe.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
This is where I thank my fantastic teammeats- I mean mates, Silber and Vince. We weren't sure we could get everything we needed to done, but here we are. Almost done. Really, like, I'm just waiting on some things, and Silber is putting finishing touches- it'll work out, we got this.
Thanks to vezaz for giving solid crit at way-too-late at night, and my friend from college who invited me over to his sister's birthday party and gave me four hours of Cards Against Humanity that worked wonders at destressing, got me some new friends, and provided a great winning streak.
You can close the curtains, now, guys. I'm either dead or sleeping. No, no, it doesn't matter which. We're done here.
Hell yes.
